description: A single narrow hanging dungeon iron chain, front side view. Six regular small oval links alternate face-on and edge-on in one vertical straight line, dark forged iron, one thin cool gray highlight on the upper left, tiny dull brown rust accent. Small ceiling anchor at the top and complete closed rounded link at the bottom. Total object only 7 pixels wide and 54 pixels tall, centered on transparent 16x64 canvas with margins. Crisp chunky fantasy game pixel art. Simple 1 pixel dark outlines, restrained flat material planes, no knots, no background, no wall, no character, no text, no glow. Separate every open link hole clearly.
